# ada-idna

UTS #46 domain-to-ASCII from [Ada](https://github.com/ada-url/ada) by Yagiz Nizipli and Daniel
Lemire, the URL library Node uses, ported to C: `URL` hosts come out exactly as Node's.
MIT license (`LICENSE-MIT`; Ada is also Apache-2.0).

- **Upstream:** `src/ada_idna.cpp` of Ada **v2.9.2** (commit
  `1cca580d8586ca3818d43e0bb11c7a47d77ca5ee`), the version Node v22 bundles
  (`process.versions.ada`); IDNA 15.0.0.
- **`idna_tables.h`** is generated by `convert.mjs` from that file: the mapping table (packed:
  first code point, status and mapping length in 32 bits, the mapping's index apart), the bidi
  classes, and the code point sets of the label rules as ranges.
- **`idna.c`** is the algorithm (mapping, punycode, label validity, to-ASCII), converted by hand
  from C++ to C step for step, Ada's quirks included (they are Node's behavior). Normalization to
  NFC uses QuickJS's libunicode (`third_party/quickjs-regexp`) instead of Ada's tables.
- **Used by:** the url component (`runtime/src/url.c`), only in programs that name `URL` or
  `URLSearchParams`; the tables are about 80 KiB.

## Updating

```sh
git clone --branch v<ada version Node bundles> https://github.com/ada-url/ada
node runtime/third_party/ada-idna/convert.mjs ada/src/ada_idna.cpp   # writes idna_tables.h
```

Then compare `idna.c` with the new `ada_idna.cpp` (mapping.cpp, punycode.cpp, validity.cpp,
to_ascii.cpp), and rerun `tests/programs/url-wpt.js` against the Node it should match.
